$comment: A recorded cold review, so make check can exercise the whole loop with no model and no network. Re-recorded by make e2e-live. What the reviewer was given is here too, because the interesting claim is what it was NOT given.
withheld: the account of how the work went

claimed.gateLine: VERDICT: PASS every selected check passed

findings.what: The empty state was changed, and so was the unreachable state beside it. The task named one component and one behaviour; altering the error copy is a second change nobody asked for.
An existing assertion about zero shares was replaced with one that passes for any input. That is a weakened check, not a new one.
